capabilities: Edit mindmaps with bidirectional Markdown synchronization
Generate views from vault folders, tags, and chain-of-thought outlines
Expand or decompose nodes via an OpenAI-compatible API
Export mindmaps to PNG, JPEG, HTML, Canvas, Excalidraw, or Markdown
extras: Freemium: basic editing, Markdown sync, and views are free, but some features require a paid license verified through a remote license server. AI features send the current file's node content to a configurable external endpoint.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in interactive mindmap view that stays synchronized with Markdown headings and lists.

relations.evidence: Export — export to PNG, JPEG, HTML, Canvas, Excalidraw, or Markdown.

summary: Interactive mindmap editor that syncs bidirectionally with Markdown, offers folder/tag/chain-of-thought views, AI node expansion, and slide export.
